description: Dependency automation for a security boundary built on pins: SHA-pinned actions, uv.lock, and tool version pins all rot without an updater. Grouped weekly PRs keep the noise low; every update still lands through protected main.

packageRules.description: One grouped PR for all GitHub Actions bumps, always digest-pinned with a version comment
Group Python dependency updates (pyproject ranges resolve into uv.lock)

customManagers.description: Version-pinned tools installed inline in workflows (uv, build)
Databricks CLI pin in the Codex setup script; its per-arch SHA-256 checksums and the databricks/setup-cli action SHA must be updated in the same PR
